span.p:
One connector per service: outbox-<service>
PostgresConnector · pgoutput
publication pmart_outbox · slot pmart_outbox_<service>
table public.outbox_event only · snapshot no_data
── EventRouter SMT ──
topic = outbox.topic column · key = aggregateid
headers eventType · aggregateType · traceId · correlationId
DELETE ignored · errors.tolerance=none
